﻿﻿This mod adds 15+ seasonal outdoor buildings you can have Robin instantly built for you.
All fountains in this pack were beautifully animated by one of my dearest friends and animation master: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/24986819]Gervig91[/url]. 
This outdoor set was made to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14442]Yri's Romantic Farm[/url], using some of Yri's assets with her express permission. ﻿

Arches and gazebos are all included in this pack, due to the fact you can't add pass-through furniture
into the game. However, Robin will instantly build them for you, so time shouldn't be a concern.

The Romantic Fountain, featured in this mod, is based on Fabflub's beautiful sims 4 lot:
[url=https://www.thesimsresource.com/downloads/details/category/sims4-lots-community/title/the-roman-fountain-no-cc/id/1392961/]The Roman Fountain[/url].﻿
